title: AI and Disruptive Technology Strategy
description: Focuses on how AI will redefine businesses in the digital age. Studies the fundamental topics of innovation driven by AI+X revolution, disruptive technologies, and digital transformation. Covers the TOE theory and S curves to discriminate between trends and fads, how to make decisions about investment in technologies and new ventures, and a look into the game changers in many industries (e.g., high tech, finance, healthcare). Prepares students to become leaders in the tech-intensive world. Students may not earn credit for both MGT 451 and MGT 451R. Prerequisites: MBA student or instructor approval.
